# Command line

Every `indus` command with its arguments, options and subcommands.

Every command also accepts `--help`, which prints the same text in the terminal.

## indus

Indus Agent: a terminal agent that can run commands, edit files and search the web.

Run `indus` with no command to start a chat.

```text
indus [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-V, --version` | flag |  | Show the version and how Indus Agent was installed. |
| `-p, --profile` | TEXT |  | Run against the named profile (works in any position). |
| `-z, --oneshot` | TEXT |  | Answer one prompt and print only the final reply (for scripts). |
| `--usage-file` | TEXT |  | With -z: write a JSON usage report to PATH, even when the run fails. |
| `-m, --model` | TEXT |  | Model for this run. |
| `--provider` | TEXT |  | Provider for this run. |
| `--reasoning` | TEXT |  | Reasoning effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra. |
| `-t, --toolsets` | TEXT |  | Comma-separated toolsets to enable. |
| `-r, --resume` | TEXT |  | Resume a session by id or title; 'latest' picks the newest one here. |
| `-c, --continue` | TEXT |  | Continue the session called NAME, or the newest one when no name is given. |
| `--in` | TEXT |  | Work in DIR: change into it first and keep the session there. |
| `--no-restore-cwd` | flag |  | Stay in the current directory when resuming. |
| `-s, --skills` | TEXT (repeatable) |  | Skills to preload (repeat the flag or separate with commas). |
| `-w, --worktree` | TEXT |  | Start the session in a new git worktree of this repository (named NAME). |
| `--checkpoints` | flag |  | Snapshot the working folder before file changes (/rollback restores). |
| `--yolo` | flag |  | Run risky commands without asking. |
| `--accept-hooks` | flag |  | Run the configured shell hooks without asking about new ones first. |
| `--pass-session-id` | flag |  | Tell the model its session id. |
| `--ignore-user-config` | flag |  | Use built-in settings instead of config.yaml (.env still loads). |
| `--ignore-rules` | flag |  | Skip project rules files, memory and preloaded skills. |
| `--safe-mode` | flag |  | Troubleshoot with every customisation off (implies both --ignore flags). |
| `--tui / --cli` | flag |  | Pick the full-screen interface or the classic prompt. |
| `--local` | flag |  | Run the agent in this terminal instead of the profile's gateway daemon. |

## indus chat

Chat with the agent (the default when `indus` is run with no command).

```text
indus chat [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-q, --query` | TEXT |  | A first message. On a terminal it opens the chat with this message sent as typed; with --oneshot, -Q or without a terminal the answer is printed and the command exits. |
| `--query-file` | TEXT |  | Read the message from PATH ('-' reads stdin); nothing in it is interpreted. |
| `--oneshot` | flag |  | With -q: answer and exit instead of opening the chat. |
| `-Q, --quiet` | flag |  | Print only the reply. |
| `--max-turns` | INTEGER |  | Tool-call cap per turn. |
| `--source` | TEXT |  | Tag stored with the session (default: cli; 'tool' hides it from session lists). |
| `--voice` | flag |  | Start with voice mode on: hold the record key (Ctrl+Space) to talk. |
| `--save-trajectories` | flag |  | After each turn, append the conversation as a training sample to trajectory_samples.jsonl (or failed_trajectories.jsonl) in the working directory. |
| `-m, --model` | TEXT |  | Model for this run. |
| `--provider` | TEXT |  | Provider for this run. |
| `--reasoning` | TEXT |  | Reasoning effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra. |
| `-t, --toolsets` | TEXT |  | Comma-separated toolsets to enable. |
| `-r, --resume` | TEXT |  | Resume a session by id or title; 'latest' picks the newest one here. |
| `-c, --continue` | TEXT |  | Continue the session called NAME, or the newest one when no name is given. |
| `--in` | TEXT |  | Work in DIR: change into it first and keep the session there. |
| `--no-restore-cwd` | flag |  | Stay in the current directory when resuming. |
| `-s, --skills` | TEXT (repeatable) |  | Skills to preload (repeat the flag or separate with commas). |
| `-w, --worktree` | TEXT |  | Start the session in a new git worktree of this repository (named NAME). |
| `--checkpoints` | flag |  | Snapshot the working folder before file changes (/rollback restores). |
| `--yolo` | flag |  | Run risky commands without asking. |
| `--accept-hooks` | flag |  | Run the configured shell hooks without asking about new ones first. |
| `--pass-session-id` | flag |  | Tell the model its session id. |
| `--ignore-user-config` | flag |  | Use built-in settings instead of config.yaml (.env still loads). |
| `--ignore-rules` | flag |  | Skip project rules files, memory and preloaded skills. |
| `--safe-mode` | flag |  | Troubleshoot with every customisation off (implies both --ignore flags). |
| `--tui / --cli` | flag |  | Pick the full-screen interface or the classic prompt. |
| `--local` | flag |  | Run the agent in this terminal instead of the profile's gateway daemon. |

## indus model

Choose the provider and model for chats (asks questions; needs a terminal).

```text
indus model [OPTIONS]
```

|---|---|---|---|
| `--refresh` | flag |  | Fetch model lists again instead of the saved ones. |

## indus fallback

Routes tried in order when the main model fails (list, add, remove, clear).

```text
indus fallback [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`indus fallback add`](#indus-fallback-add) | Add a route: pick it like `indus model`, or name PROVIDER MODEL. |
| [`indus fallback clear`](#indus-fallback-clear) | Remove every entry (asks first unless -y). |
| [`indus fallback list`](#indus-fallback-list) | Show the chain (the default; alias ls). |
| [`indus fallback remove`](#indus-fallback-remove) | Remove an entry: pick it, or give its number (alias rm). |

### indus fallback add

Add a route: pick it like `indus model`, or name PROVIDER MODEL.

```text
indus fallback add [OPTIONS] [PROVIDER] [MODEL]
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `PROVIDER` | no | 1 |
| `MODEL` | no | 1 |

### indus fallback clear

Remove every entry (asks first unless -y).

```text
indus fallback clear [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-y, --yes` | flag |  | Do not ask for confirmation. |

### indus fallback list

Show the chain (the default; alias ls).

```text
indus fallback list [OPTIONS]
```

### indus fallback remove

Remove an entry: pick it, or give its number (alias rm).

```text
indus fallback remove [OPTIONS] [INDEX]
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `INDEX` | no | 1 |

## indus setup

Set up Indus Agent step by step: model and key, terminal, tools, agent defaults. SECTION (model, terminal, tools, agent, gateway) runs only that part.

```text
indus setup [OPTIONS] [SECTION]
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `[SECTION]` | no | 1 |

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--non-interactive` | flag |  | Do not ask anything: print how to set things up with commands instead. |
| `--reset` | flag |  | Start from the built-in settings (the current file is backed up first). |
| `--quick` | flag |  | On a set-up install, ask only about what is still missing. |
| `--terminal-backend` | TEXT |  | Select this terminal backend without asking; its credentials are read from the environment and kept in the secret store. |

## indus auth

Manage provider credentials: keys, sign-ins and credential pools.

```text
indus auth [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`indus auth add`](#indus-auth-add) | Add an API key or sign in, as a new credential in PROVIDER's pool. |
| [`indus auth list`](#indus-auth-list) | Show each credential pool (or just PROVIDER's). |
| [`indus auth remove`](#indus-auth-remove) | Remove a credential by index, id or label (its stored secret too). |
| [`indus auth reset`](#indus-auth-reset) | Put benched credentials back in rotation (all of PROVIDER's, or one). |
| [`indus auth priority`](#indus-auth-priority) | Move a credential to PRIORITY (0 = tried first); the others shift. |
| [`indus auth refresh`](#indus-auth-refresh) | Renew a signed-in credential's tokens and put it back in rotation. |
| [`indus auth status`](#indus-auth-status) | Summarise PROVIDER: credentials, strategy, sign-in and what would be used next. |
| [`indus auth logout`](#indus-auth-logout) | Forget everything stored for PROVIDER (credentials and sign-in state). |

### indus auth add

Add an API key or sign in, as a new credential in PROVIDER's pool.

```text
indus auth add [OPTIONS] PROVIDER
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `PROVIDER` | yes | 1 |

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--type` | api-key \| api_key \| oauth |  | api-key (default) or oauth (the provider's documented browser or device sign-in). |
| `--label` | TEXT |  | A name to tell this credential apart. |
| `--priority` | INTEGER |  | Place it at this position (0 = tried first). |
| `--api-key` | TEXT |  | The key (asked for, hidden, if omitted). |
| `--no-browser` | flag |  | Never open a browser; print the address. |
| `--timeout` | FLOAT | `300.0` | Seconds to wait for sign-in. |
| `--ca-bundle` | TEXT |  | Trust this CA bundle for sign-in. |
| `--insecure` | flag |  | Skip TLS certificate checks (unsafe). |

### indus auth list

Show each credential pool (or just PROVIDER's).

```text
indus auth list [OPTIONS] [PROVIDER]
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `PROVIDER` | no | 1 |

### indus auth remove

Remove a credential by index, id or label (its stored secret too).

```text
indus auth remove [OPTIONS] PROVIDER TARGET
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `PROVIDER` | yes | 1 |
| `TARGET` | yes | 1 |

### indus auth reset

Put benched credentials back in rotation (all of PROVIDER's, or one).

```text
indus auth reset [OPTIONS] PROVIDER [TARGET]
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `PROVIDER` | yes | 1 |
| `TARGET` | no | 1 |

### indus auth priority

Move a credential to PRIORITY (0 = tried first); the others shift.

```text
indus auth priority [OPTIONS] PROVIDER TARGET PRIORITY
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `PROVIDER` | yes | 1 |
| `TARGET` | yes | 1 |
| `PRIORITY` | yes | 1 |

### indus auth refresh

Renew a signed-in credential's tokens and put it back in rotation.

```text
indus auth refresh [OPTIONS] PROVIDER [TARGET]
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `PROVIDER` | yes | 1 |
| `TARGET` | no | 1 |

### indus auth status

Summarise PROVIDER: credentials, strategy, sign-in and what would be used next.

```text
indus auth status [OPTIONS] PROVIDER
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `PROVIDER` | yes | 1 |

### indus auth logout

Forget everything stored for PROVIDER (credentials and sign-in state).

```text
indus auth logout [OPTIONS] PROVIDER
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `PROVIDER` | yes | 1 |

## indus status

Show the model, provider, credentials, backend and session store at a glance.

```text
indus status [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--full, --all` | flag |  | Show every section. |
| `--deep` | flag |  | Also run the slower checks (implies --full). |

## indus doctor

Check this profile's setup and point at (or fix) what is wrong.

```text
indus doctor [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fix` | flag |  | Repair what can be repaired safely. |
| `--live` | flag |  | Also call each provider with a key (bounded). |
| `--ack` | TEXT |  | Acknowledge a security advisory. |
| `--minimal` | flag |  | Only the basic report: home, config, keys, store. |
| `--json` | flag |  | With --minimal: print JSON. |

## indus approvals

Check how the approval rules treat commands.

```text
indus approvals [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`indus approvals test`](#indus-approvals-test) | Show whether a command would run, need approval or be refused, without running it. |

### indus approvals test

Show whether a command would run, need approval or be refused, without running it. Put -- before the command so its own flags are not read as ours. Exit codes: 0 allow, 2 would ask, 3 deny.

```text
indus approvals test [OPTIONS] [WORDS]...
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `WORDS` | no | many |

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--backend` | TEXT | `local` | Terminal backend to judge for. |
| `--json` | flag |  | Print the verdict as JSON. |

## indus dump

Print a compact setup summary for support requests (no secret values).

```text
indus dump [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--show-keys` | flag |  | Show the first and last four characters of each key. |

## indus backup

Back up the whole Indus Agent home (every profile) into one zip file.

```text
indus backup [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-o, --output` | TEXT |  | Zip file or folder to write. |
| `-q, --quick` | flag |  | Snapshot this profile's key files instead. |
| `-l, --label` | TEXT |  | With --quick: a word added to the name. |
| `-k, --keep` | INTEGER RANGE | `3` | Keep this many indus-backup-*.zip files in the output folder (0 = all). |

## indus checkpoints

Inspect and trim the file snapshots taken before risky edits.

```text
indus checkpoints [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`indus checkpoints status`](#indus-checkpoints-status) | Total size, project count and one row per project. |
| [`indus checkpoints list`](#indus-checkpoints-list) | The same as status. |
| [`indus checkpoints prune`](#indus-checkpoints-prune) | Delete orphaned, unused and oversized checkpoint history. |
| [`indus checkpoints clear`](#indus-checkpoints-clear) | Delete every checkpoint of every folder (cannot be undone). |

### indus checkpoints status

Total size, project count and one row per project.

```text
indus checkpoints status [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | INTEGER | `20` | Rows to show. |

### indus checkpoints list

The same as status.

```text
indus checkpoints list [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | INTEGER | `20` | Rows to show. |

### indus checkpoints prune

Delete orphaned, unused and oversized checkpoint history.

```text
indus checkpoints prune [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--retention-days` | INTEGER RANGE | `7` | Delete projects not used for this many days. |
| `--max-size-mb` | INTEGER RANGE | `500` | Then delete the oldest projects until the store is at most this size. |
| `--keep-orphans` | flag |  | Keep projects whose folder no longer exists. |
| `-f, --force` | flag |  | Do not ask before deleting orphans. |

### indus checkpoints clear

Delete every checkpoint of every folder (cannot be undone).

```text
indus checkpoints clear [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-f, --force` | flag |  | Do not ask first. |

## indus config

Show and change settings. With no subcommand, the same as `indus config show`.

```text
indus config [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`indus config show`](#indus-config-show) | Print the effective settings with every credential masked. |
| [`indus config get`](#indus-config-get) | Print one value. |
| [`indus config set`](#indus-config-set) | Set KEY to VALUE: credentials go to the keychain, UPPER_SNAKE names to .env, everything else to the settings file. |
| [`indus config unset`](#indus-config-unset) | Remove KEY from wherever `config set` would have put it. |
| [`indus config edit`](#indus-config-edit) | Open the settings file in $VISUAL or $EDITOR (created if missing). |
| [`indus config check`](#indus-config-check) | Report problems in the settings file without changing it. |
| [`indus config migrate`](#indus-config-migrate) | Bring the settings file up to this version (dry run by default). |
| [`indus config path`](#indus-config-path) | Print the path of the settings file. |
| [`indus config env-path`](#indus-config-env-path) | Print the path of the profile's .env file. |

### indus config show

Print the effective settings with every credential masked.

```text
indus config show [OPTIONS]
```

### indus config get

Print one value. Credentials are masked unless --raw is given.

```text
indus config get [OPTIONS] KEY
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `KEY` | yes | 1 |

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag |  | Print the value as JSON. |
| `--raw` | flag |  | Print credentials unmasked. |

### indus config set

Set KEY to VALUE: credentials go to the keychain, UPPER_SNAKE names to .env, everything else to the settings file.

```text
indus config set [OPTIONS] KEY VALUE
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `KEY` | yes | 1 |
| `VALUE` | yes | 1 |

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--force` | flag |  | Write a key this version does not know, or replace a whole section with one value. |

### indus config unset

Remove KEY from wherever `config set` would have put it.

```text
indus config unset [OPTIONS] KEY
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `KEY` | yes | 1 |

### indus config edit

Open the settings file in $VISUAL or $EDITOR (created if missing).

```text
indus config edit [OPTIONS]
```

### indus config check

Report problems in the settings file without changing it.

```text
indus config check [OPTIONS]
```

### indus config migrate

Bring the settings file up to this version (dry run by default).

```text
indus config migrate [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--apply` | flag |  | Write the migrated file (after a backup). |

### indus config path

Print the path of the settings file.

```text
indus config path [OPTIONS]
```

### indus config env-path

Print the path of the profile's .env file.

```text
indus config env-path [OPTIONS]
```

## indus tools

Choose which toolsets each platform gets. With no subcommand: a checklist on a terminal, else the list.

```text
indus tools [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--summary` | flag |  | Print the enabled toolsets of every platform. |
| `--platform` | TEXT | `cli` | Platform whose toolsets to use. |

## indus sessions

Look at, export and tidy your saved conversations.

```text
indus sessions [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`indus sessions list`](#indus-sessions-list) | List recent sessions, newest first. |
| [`indus sessions browse`](#indus-sessions-browse) | Pick a session to resume (without a terminal: print the list). |
| [`indus sessions pinned`](#indus-sessions-pinned) | List pinned sessions. |
| [`indus sessions rename`](#indus-sessions-rename) | Give a session a title. |
| [`indus sessions delete`](#indus-sessions-delete) | Delete a session, its continuations and the sub-agent runs it started. |
| [`indus sessions pin`](#indus-sessions-pin) | Pin sessions: pruning and auto-archive leave them alone. |
| [`indus sessions unpin`](#indus-sessions-unpin) | Remove the pin from sessions. |
| [`indus sessions stats`](#indus-sessions-stats) | Counts and size of the session store. |
| [`indus sessions export`](#indus-sessions-export) | Export sessions as JSON lines, Markdown or HTML (secrets masked unless --no-redact). |
| [`indus sessions prune`](#indus-sessions-prune) | Delete old ended sessions (bare: quiet for 90 days); shows the list first. |
| [`indus sessions archive`](#indus-sessions-archive) | Archive (hide from lists, keep) the sessions matching the filters. |
| [`indus sessions optimize`](#indus-sessions-optimize) | Give unused space back to the disk (VACUUM); skipped while the store is in use. |
| [`indus sessions repair`](#indus-sessions-repair) | Check the session store and rebuild its search index when that is what is wrong. |
| [`indus sessions recover`](#indus-sessions-recover) | Copy every row that can still be read into a new store file. |
| [`indus sessions import`](#indus-sessions-import) | Import sessions from a JSON-lines export (all of it, or nothing). |

### indus sessions export

Export sessions as JSON lines, Markdown or HTML (secrets masked unless --no-redact).

```text
indus sessions export [OPTIONS] [OUTPUT]
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `OUTPUT` | no | 1 |

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` | jsonl \| md \| html | `jsonl` | jsonl (one file, re-importable), md or html (one file per session). |
| `--session-id` | TEXT |  | Export only this session (id, prefix or title). |
| `--redact / --no-redact` | flag | --redact | Mask API keys, tokens and other secrets in the export. |
| `--force` | flag |  | Overwrite files that already exist. |
| `--older-than` | TEXT |  | Only sessions last active before AGE ago (5h, 2d, 1w) or a date. |
| `--newer-than` | TEXT |  | Only sessions active within AGE (5h, 2d, 1w) or since a date. |
| `--before` | TEXT |  | Only sessions started before TIME. |
| `--after` | TEXT |  | Only sessions started at or after TIME. |
| `--source` | TEXT (repeatable) |  | Only sessions from this source (cli, telegram, ...); may repeat. |
| `--title` | TEXT |  | Only titles containing this text. |
| `--cwd` | TEXT |  | Only sessions whose folder is under this path. |
| `--min-messages` | INTEGER |  | At least N messages. |
| `--max-messages` | INTEGER |  | At most N messages. |
| `--model` | TEXT |  | Only models whose name contains this text. |
| `--provider` | TEXT |  | Only sessions billed by this provider. |
| `--dry-run` | flag |  | Show what matches and change nothing. |
| `-y, --yes` | flag |  | Do not ask first. |

### indus sessions prune

|---|---|---|---|

| `--force` | flag |  | Run even while the store is open elsewhere. |
| `--older-than` | TEXT |  | Delete sessions last active before AGE ago (5h, 2d, 1w) or a date; a bare prune means 90 days, any other filter alone matches every age. |
| `--newer-than` | TEXT |  | Only sessions active within AGE (5h, 2d, 1w) or since a date. |
| `--before` | TEXT |  | Only sessions started before TIME. |
| `--after` | TEXT |  | Only sessions started at or after TIME. |
| `--source` | TEXT (repeatable) |  | Only sessions from this source (cli, telegram, ...); may repeat. |
| `--title` | TEXT |  | Only titles containing this text. |
| `--cwd` | TEXT |  | Only sessions whose folder is under this path. |
| `--min-messages` | INTEGER |  | At least N messages. |
| `--max-messages` | INTEGER |  | At most N messages. |
| `--model` | TEXT |  | Only models whose name contains this text. |
| `--provider` | TEXT |  | Only sessions billed by this provider. |
| `--dry-run` | flag |  | Show what matches and change nothing. |
| `-y, --yes` | flag |  | Do not ask first. |

## indus profile

Create, switch and manage profiles. With no subcommand, the same as `profile list`.

```text
indus profile [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|

| [`indus profile show`](#indus-profile-show) | Show one profile's details. |
| [`indus profile create`](#indus-profile-create) | Create a profile, empty or cloned from another one. |
| [`indus profile delete`](#indus-profile-delete) | Delete a profile (it cannot be brought back). |
| [`indus profile rename`](#indus-profile-rename) | Rename a profile. |
| [`indus profile describe`](#indus-profile-describe) | Show or set what a profile is for. |
| [`indus profile alias`](#indus-profile-alias) | Write (or remove) a command that starts indus with a profile. |

### indus profile list


|---|---|---|

| `--clone-all` | flag |  | Copy everything except history and runtime state. |
| `--clone-from` | TEXT |  | Clone this profile (default: the current one). |


| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `SHELL` | no | 1 |

| `--component` | agent \| tools \| cli \| gateway \| cron |  | Only records from one part of the program. |

## indus skills

List, check and sync skills.

```text
indus skills [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`indus skills list`](#indus-skills-list) | List the skills of this profile. |
| [`indus skills view`](#indus-skills-view) | Print a skill's SKILL.md and list its support files. |
| [`indus skills check`](#indus-skills-check) | Validate every skill and run the linter; exit 1 when one is invalid. |
| [`indus skills list-modified`](#indus-skills-list-modified) | List shipped skills you have edited (sync leaves them alone). |
| [`indus skills diff`](#indus-skills-diff) | Show how your copy of a shipped skill differs from the shipped one. |
| [`indus skills sync`](#indus-skills-sync) | Copy new and updated shipped skills (your edits are kept). |
| [`indus skills opt-out`](#indus-skills-opt-out) | Stop copying shipped skills into this profile. |
| [`indus skills opt-in`](#indus-skills-opt-in) | Copy shipped skills into this profile again. |
| [`indus skills reset`](#indus-skills-reset) | Forget where a shipped skill came from, or restore the shipped copy. |
| [`indus skills pending`](#indus-skills-pending) | List skill writes waiting for approval. |
| [`indus skills approve`](#indus-skills-approve) | Apply waiting skill writes (ids, or all) and show their diffs. |
| [`indus skills reject`](#indus-skills-reject) | Drop waiting skill writes (ids, or all). |
| [`indus skills browse`](#indus-skills-browse) | List hub skills from the catalogue and your taps. |
| [`indus skills search`](#indus-skills-search) | Search the hub for skills. |
| [`indus skills inspect`](#indus-skills-inspect) | Fetch and scan a hub skill without installing it. |
| [`indus skills install`](#indus-skills-install) | Install a skill from the hub (scanned first). |
| [`indus skills check-updates`](#indus-skills-check-updates) | Check hub skills for upstream changes (``check`` validates skill files). |
| [`indus skills update`](#indus-skills-update) | Reinstall hub skills whose upstream changed (your edits are kept). |
| [`indus skills audit`](#indus-skills-audit) | Scan every hub skill again. |
| [`indus skills uninstall`](#indus-skills-uninstall) | Remove a skill the hub installed. |
| [`indus skills tap`](#indus-skills-tap) | GitHub repos searched for skills. |
| [`indus skills trust`](#indus-skills-trust) | Raise a tap to trusted (only publishers on the built-in list). |
| [`indus skills untrust`](#indus-skills-untrust) | Put a tap back to community trust. |
| [`indus skills trust-project`](#indus-skills-trust-project) | Load the skills of this repo (its .indus/skills and .agents/skills). |
| [`indus skills publish`](#indus-skills-publish) | Share a local skill on GitHub (a branch and a pull request). |
| [`indus skills snapshot`](#indus-skills-snapshot) | Export or import the hub skills of this profile. |

## indus curator

Look after the skills the agent wrote for itself.

```text
indus curator [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`indus curator status`](#indus-curator-status) | Show the curator's state and the skills it looks after. |
| [`indus curator run`](#indus-curator-run) | Run a curator pass now. |
| [`indus curator pause`](#indus-curator-pause) | Stop automatic runs until `resume`. |
| [`indus curator resume`](#indus-curator-resume) | Allow automatic runs again. |
| [`indus curator pin`](#indus-curator-pin) | Keep a managed skill out of every curator change. |

| [`indus curator backup`](#indus-curator-backup) | Snapshot the skills folder now. |
| [`indus curator rollback`](#indus-curator-rollback) | Restore the whole skills folder from a snapshot (the newest by default). |

## indus cron

Schedule jobs and look after them.

```text
indus cron [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`indus cron create`](#indus-cron-create) | Create a job: SCHEDULE like "every 30m", "weekdays at 9am" or "in 2h". |
| [`indus cron edit`](#indus-cron-edit) | Change a job's fields. |
| [`indus cron list`](#indus-cron-list) | List the jobs with their next run, last result and warnings. |
| [`indus cron pause`](#indus-cron-pause) | Pause a job: it does not fire until resumed. |
| [`indus cron resume`](#indus-cron-resume) | Resume a paused job. |
| [`indus cron run`](#indus-cron-run) | Run a job now and wait for it (does not move its schedule). |
| [`indus cron remove`](#indus-cron-remove) | Delete a job, its notepad and its incidents (output documents stay). |
| [`indus cron status`](#indus-cron-status) | Is the ticker alive, when does the next job run, is the store healthy? |
| [`indus cron tick`](#indus-cron-tick) | Run one scheduler pass now (for a user timer) and wait for its jobs. |
| [`indus cron daemon`](#indus-cron-daemon) | Run the scheduler every minute until stopped (Ctrl+C / SIGTERM). |
| [`indus cron pause-all`](#indus-cron-pause-all) | Emergency stop: no scheduled run starts until resume-all (manual runs still work). |
| [`indus cron resume-all`](#indus-cron-resume-all) | Undo pause-all. |
| [`indus cron runs`](#indus-cron-runs) | The recorded runs of one job, newest first. |
| [`indus cron history`](#indus-cron-history) | Recent runs of every job, newest first. |
| [`indus cron incidents`](#indus-cron-incidents) | Failures grouped by job and error; acknowledge one to silence it. |
| [`indus cron notepad`](#indus-cron-notepad) | A job's own notes kept between runs (cursors, last-seen ids). |
| [`indus cron doctor`](#indus-cron-doctor) | Check every active job (read-only); exit 1 while anything needs attention. |
| [`indus cron suggestions`](#indus-cron-suggestions) | Suggested jobs: nothing is scheduled until you accept one. |

### indus cron create

Create a job: SCHEDULE like "every 30m", "weekdays at 9am" or "in 2h".

```text
indus cron create [OPTIONS] SCHEDULE [PROMPT]...
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `SCHEDULE` | yes | 1 |
| `PROMPT` | no | many |

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | TEXT |  | A short name for the job. |
| `--deliver` | TEXT |  | Where results go (default: local). |
| `--failure-deliver` | TEXT |  | Where failure notices go. |
| `--script` | TEXT |  | A script file in <home>/scripts/. |
| `--workdir` | TEXT |  | Absolute folder to work in ('' clears). |
| `--toolsets` | TEXT |  | Comma list of toolsets for the job. |
| `--monitor` | TEXT |  | A URL or script that gates the run. |
| `--model` | TEXT |  | Pin a model for this job. |
| `--provider` | TEXT |  | Pin a provider for this job. |
| `--base-url` | TEXT |  | Endpoint of the pinned provider. |
| `--reasoning` | TEXT |  | Reasoning effort for this job. |
| `--repeat` | INTEGER |  | Runs before the job ends. |
| `--context-from` | TEXT (repeatable) |  | Another job whose last result is context. |
| `--skill` | TEXT (repeatable) |  | A skill to load first (repeatable). |
| `--no-agent` | flag |  | Script-only: no model, the output is the job. |
| `--paused` | flag |  | Store the job paused. |
| `--reason` | TEXT |  | With --paused: why. |

## indus gateway

Run and look after the messaging gateway of this profile.

```text
indus gateway [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`indus gateway run`](#indus-gateway-run) | Run the messaging gateway in the foreground (one per profile). |
| [`indus gateway ensure`](#indus-gateway-ensure) | Make sure the gateway runs (start it if needed) and print where clients attach. |
| [`indus gateway api-key`](#indus-gateway-api-key) | Make, list and revoke the keys clients use with the gateway's HTTP API. |
| [`indus gateway setup`](#indus-gateway-setup) | Set up a messaging platform step by step: credentials, who may talk to the bot, a connection check. |
| [`indus gateway grant`](#indus-gateway-grant) | Print a single-use attach grant for a client of the daemon (used by the TUI). |
| [`indus gateway start`](#indus-gateway-start) | Start the gateway in the background (or its service). |
| [`indus gateway stop`](#indus-gateway-stop) | Stop the gateway (it finishes or hands over running work). |
| [`indus gateway restart`](#indus-gateway-restart) | Restart the gateway. |
| [`indus gateway status`](#indus-gateway-status) | Is the gateway running, and how are its platforms? |
| [`indus gateway install`](#indus-gateway-install) | Install the gateway as a user service (no root needed). |
| [`indus gateway uninstall`](#indus-gateway-uninstall) | Stop and remove the gateway's user service. |

### indus gateway run

Run the messaging gateway in the foreground (one per profile).

```text
indus gateway run [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--replace` | flag |  | Stop a gateway already serving this profile and take over. |

### indus gateway ensure

Make sure the gateway runs (start it if needed) and print where clients attach.

```text
indus gateway ensure [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag |  | Print the endpoint as JSON. |
| `--timeout` | FLOAT RANGE | `60.0` | Seconds to wait for the gateway to answer. |
| `--no-start` | flag |  | Only look for a running gateway. |

### indus gateway api-key

Make, list and revoke the keys clients use with the gateway's HTTP API.

```text
indus gateway api-key [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`indus gateway api-key create`](#indus-gateway-api-key-create) | Make a new key and print it once. |
| [`indus gateway api-key list`](#indus-gateway-api-key-list) | Show the keys (id, label, created); never their values. |
| [`indus gateway api-key revoke`](#indus-gateway-api-key-revoke) | Remove a key; clients using it are refused from the next request. |

### indus gateway api-key create

Make a new key and print it once.

```text
indus gateway api-key create [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--label` | TEXT | `""` | A note to tell keys apart (for example the client). |

### indus gateway api-key list

Show the keys (id, label, created); never their values.

```text
indus gateway api-key list [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag |  | Print JSON. |

### indus gateway api-key revoke

Remove a key; clients using it are refused from the next request.

```text
indus gateway api-key revoke [OPTIONS] KEY_ID
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `KEY_ID` | yes | 1 |

### indus gateway setup

Set up a messaging platform step by step: credentials, who may talk to the bot, a connection check. PLATFORM picks one; without it a menu lists them all.

```text
indus gateway setup [OPTIONS] [PLATFORM]
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `PLATFORM` | no | 1 |

### indus gateway grant

Print a single-use attach grant for a client of the daemon (used by the TUI).

```text
indus gateway grant [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag |  | Mint a grant and print it as JSON. |
| `--mode` | start \| discover \| recover | `start` | start: start the daemon when none answers; discover: only a running one; recover: re-ensure after a lost connection. |
| `--timeout` | FLOAT |  | Seconds to wait. |

### indus gateway start

Start the gateway in the background (or its service).

```text
indus gateway start [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--wait` | FLOAT | `30.0` | Seconds to wait for it to answer. |

### indus gateway stop

Stop the gateway (it finishes or hands over running work).

```text
indus gateway stop [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--timeout` | FLOAT |  | Seconds to wait for it to exit (default: the service's stop budget). |
| `--force` | flag |  | Kill it if it is still running after the wait. |

### indus gateway restart

Restart the gateway.

```text
indus gateway restart [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--wait` | FLOAT | `30.0` | Seconds to wait for it to answer again. |

### indus gateway status

Is the gateway running, and how are its platforms?

```text
indus gateway status [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag |  | Print JSON for scripts. |

### indus gateway install

Install the gateway as a user service (no root needed).

```text
indus gateway install [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--force` | flag |  | Replace a different existing definition. |
| `--start` | flag |  | Start it right away. |
| `--system` | flag |  | Print a system-wide unit for an administrator instead (nothing is written). |

### indus gateway uninstall

Stop and remove the gateway's user service.

```text
indus gateway uninstall [OPTIONS]
```

## indus kanban

The task board profiles hand work to each other on. Bare `indus kanban` lists the tasks.

```text
indus kanban [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--board` | TEXT |  | Use this board. |

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`indus kanban board`](#indus-kanban-board) | List boards, or make SLUG the current board (created when new). |
| [`indus kanban create`](#indus-kanban-create) | Create a task (ready, or waiting until its parents are done). |
| [`indus kanban list`](#indus-kanban-list) | List tasks, highest priority first. |
| [`indus kanban show`](#indus-kanban-show) | A task with its links, comments, runs and recent events. |
| [`indus kanban move`](#indus-kanban-move) | Move a task by hand: ready/todo, blocked, done or archived. |
| [`indus kanban comment`](#indus-kanban-comment) | Add a comment to a task. |
| [`indus kanban attach`](#indus-kanban-attach) | Attach a file (at most 25 MiB). |

| [`indus kanban review`](#indus-kanban-review) | Decide on a task waiting in review. |
| [`indus kanban dispatch`](#indus-kanban-dispatch) | Run one dispatcher pass: book finished workers and start ready tasks. |
| [`indus kanban archive`](#indus-kanban-archive) | Archive a task (a running worker's run is closed). |

## indus research

Batch runs, toolset distributions and trajectory tools.

| [`indus research swe`](#indus-research-swe) | Run coding tasks with only a terminal tool and write their trajectories. |

|---|---|---|

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|

| `--batch-size` | INTEGER RANGE |  | Prompts per batch. |
| `--distribution` | TEXT |  | Toolset distribution (`distributions`). |

| `--workers` | INTEGER RANGE |  | Worker processes. |

| `--new-dataset` | flag |  | Archive a run made with another dataset. |
| `--seed` | INTEGER |  | Seed for the toolset sampling. |
| `--reasoning-effort` | TEXT |  | One of: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max (default: the provider's). |
| `--no-reasoning` | flag |  | Switch reasoning off (sends effort none). |
| `--prefill` | TEXT |  | JSON array of prefill messages. |
| `--ephemeral-system-prompt` | TEXT |  | Used in the run, not saved. |
| `--providers-allowed` | TEXT |  | Comma list of providers to allow. |
| `--providers-ignored` | TEXT |  | Comma list of providers to skip. |
| `--providers-order` | TEXT |  | Comma list of providers to try in order. |
| `--provider-sort` | price \| throughput \| latency |  |  |
| `--max-samples` | INTEGER RANGE |  | First N prompts. |

| `--tokenizer` | TEXT |  | Tokenizer repository. |
| `--revision` | TEXT |  | Tokenizer revision (commit) to load. |
| `--trust-remote-code` | flag |  | Let the tokenizer repository run its own code (off by default). |
| `--sample-percent` | FLOAT |  | Keep this share of entries. |
| `--seed` | INTEGER | `42` | Seed for sampling. |
| `--dry-run` | flag |  | Say what would happen; write nothing. |

## indus acp

Run Indus Agent inside an editor that speaks the Agent Client Protocol (Zed, VS Code, JetBrains). The editor starts this command; stdin and stdout carry the protocol. By default sessions run in the profile's gateway daemon; --local runs them in this process.

```text
indus acp [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--local` | flag |  | Run sessions in this process instead of the daemon. |
| `--version` | flag |  | Print the version and exit. |
| `--check` | flag |  | Check that the ACP support is installed, then exit. |
| `--setup` | flag |  | Set up a provider and model in this terminal. |
| `--setup-browser` | flag |  | Install the browser tools, then exit. |
| `--yes, -y` | flag |  | With --setup-browser: accept the downloads. |

## indus update

Update this source checkout: fetch its channel, check the new code, rebuild its
environment beside the old one and restart this profile's gateway.

```text
indus update [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--check` | flag |  | Only look: exit 10 when an update is available, 0 otherwise. Installs nothing. |
| `--plan` | flag |  | Print what an update would do, as JSON. |
| `--channel` | stable \| canary \| main |  | Use this channel for this run. |
| `--set-channel` | stable \| canary \| main |  | Save the channel this install follows, then update to it. |
| `--install-id` | flag |  | Print this install's id and path. |
| `--backup` | flag |  | Take a full backup before updating. |
| `--no-backup` | flag |  | Skip the pre-update snapshot. |
| `-y, --yes` | flag |  | Answer yes to every question. |
| `--no-gateway-restart` | flag |  | Leave the gateway running on the old code (restart it later yourself). |


| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`indus egress status`](#indus-egress-status) | Show whether the proxy is on and what it injects (names only). |
| [`indus egress enable`](#indus-egress-enable) | Turn the proxy on for this profile's Docker sandboxes and start it. |
| [`indus egress disable`](#indus-egress-disable) | Turn the proxy off and stop it. |
| [`indus egress allow`](#indus-egress-allow) | Open TLS for HOST and optionally inject a secret into one header. |

### indus egress status

Show whether the proxy is on and what it injects (names only).

```text
indus egress status [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag |  | Print the state as JSON. |

### indus egress enable

Turn the proxy on for this profile's Docker sandboxes and start it.

```text
indus egress enable [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--yes, -y` | flag |  | Do it without a terminal. |

### indus egress disable

Turn the proxy off and stop it.

```text
indus egress disable [OPTIONS]
```

### indus egress allow

Open TLS for HOST and optionally inject a secret into one header.

```text
indus egress allow [OPTIONS] HOST
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `HOST` | yes | 1 |

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--secret` | TEXT | `""` | Inject this secret (by name) for the host. |
| `--header` | TEXT | `Authorization` | Header to fill. |

## indus vault

Saved logins, cards and addresses the agent can fill without seeing them.

```text
indus vault [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`indus vault add`](#indus-vault-add) | Save an item (values are asked for in hidden prompts). |
| [`indus vault list`](#indus-vault-list) | Show saved items (never their values). |
| [`indus vault lock`](#indus-vault-lock) | Stop the agent from using the local vault. |
| [`indus vault remove`](#indus-vault-remove) | Delete an item by its handle. |
| [`indus vault unlock`](#indus-vault-unlock) | Let the agent use the local vault again. |

### indus vault add

Save an item (values are asked for in hidden prompts).

```text
indus vault add [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--kind` | login \| payment \| address |  | What to save. |
| `--origin` | TEXT | `""` | The site it may be filled on, e.g. https://x.com. |
| `--label` | TEXT | `""` | A short name shown by `list`. |

### indus vault list

Show saved items (never their values).

```text
indus vault list [OPTIONS]
```

### indus vault lock

Stop the agent from using the local vault.

```text
indus vault lock [OPTIONS]
```

### indus vault remove

Delete an item by its handle.

```text
indus vault remove [OPTIONS] HANDLE
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `HANDLE` | yes | 1 |

### indus vault unlock

Let the agent use the local vault again.

```text
indus vault unlock [OPTIONS]
```

## indus blueprint

Job templates: a fixed schedule with a few blanks to fill.

```text
indus blueprint [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`indus blueprint list`](#indus-blueprint-list) | List the blueprints. |
| [`indus blueprint show`](#indus-blueprint-show) | Show a blueprint's blanks and the /cron line it fills. |
| [`indus blueprint use`](#indus-blueprint-use) | Fill a blueprint (slot=value …) and create the job. |

### indus blueprint list

List the blueprints.

```text
indus blueprint list [OPTIONS]
```

### indus blueprint show

Show a blueprint's blanks and the /cron line it fills.

```text
indus blueprint show [OPTIONS] NAME
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | yes | 1 |

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag |  | Print the form fields as JSON. |

### indus blueprint use

Fill a blueprint (slot=value …) and create the job.

```text
indus blueprint use [OPTIONS] NAME [VALUES]...
```

| Argument | Required | Count |
|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | yes | 1 |
| `VALUES` | no | many |

| Option | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | flag |  | Print the job it would create; create nothing. |

## indus pet

| [`indus pet rename`](#indus-pet-rename) | Give a pet a new name. |
